Unfiltered calls

Your calendar does the qualifying

A free clarity call with no step before it means you meet everyone: the curious, the not-yet-ready and the ones who can’t invest. Every one of those calls costs you an hour.

Nothing in the middle

Big jump from follower to client

Going from a post to a one-to-one coaching commitment is a huge step. With nothing smaller in between, most people who like your content never take it, and you never hear from them.

Organic only

Every enquiry depends on you showing up

Without an always-on front door, new clients arrive when you post or speak, and slow down when you don’t. 4,091 followers is a ceiling you hit fast.

Someone with a big goal finds you, likes what you say, and has two options: book a call with a stranger or do nothing. Most do nothing.

Is this you?

You’re not short on ambition. You’re short on a plan that sticks.

  • You set big goals every January, and by March they’re quietly back on the shelf.
  • You start strong, then life, work and other people’s priorities take over.
  • You keep asking yourself “but why haven’t I done it yet?” and don’t love the answer.
  • You want a clear, honest way to go after the goal, without burning out on the way.

Script 1 · “But why?”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Three words changed how I coach: but why?”

Body

“You want the promotion, the business, the race. But why? Most goals stall because the reason underneath isn’t clear. When it is, the hard days get easier to push through.”

CTA

“I teach the whole method in my Big Goals Masterclass. Live, 60 minutes, €17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera outdoors, natural light, greenery behind. On-screen text: “but why?”

Script 2 · “Willpower”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If your plan depends on willpower, it’s not a plan.”

Body

“Willpower runs out by Wednesday. The people who reach big goals use structure: a clear reason, a 90-day map and a weekly check-in. That’s coaching psychology, and it works without you having to be superhuman.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in my live masterclass. €17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “willpower” crossed out in copper.

Script 3 · “Same goal, different year”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Is this the third year in a row you’ve set the same goal?”

Body

“That’s not a motivation problem. It usually means something is in the way that you haven’t named yet. In 60 minutes we’ll find it, and build the plan to move past it.”
